Name: Assignment Supervisor ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the record. Supply for existing records only. You cannot supply this ID for new records.

Name: Assignment Number
Description: The number of the assignment that this assignment supervisor manages.

Name: Supervisor Assignment Number
Description: The assignment number of the supervisor.

Name: Supervisor Person Number
Description: The person number of the supervisor.

Name: Type
Description: The role the supervisor has with regards to the overall organization structure; functional, project leader and so on.

Name: Assignment ID
Description: A unique reference to the assignment that this assignment supervisor manages.

Name: Effective End Date
Description: The end date of the date-effective changes. If left blank, the effective end date is the end of time by default.

Name: Effective Start Date
Description: The start date of the record or of date-effective changes to the record.

Name: Action Code
Description: The action being performed for this assignment, such as, Hire, Add Pending Worker, Manager Change and so on.

Name: Manager ID
Description: A unique reference to the supervisor person record.

Name: New Supervisor Assignment Number
Description: If updating an existing supervisor record, the assignment number of the new supervisor.

Name: New Supervisor Person Number
Description: If updating an existing supervisor record, the person number of the new supervisor.

Name: New Supervisor Type
Description: If updating an existing supervisor record, the new supervisor type.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the assignment manager.

Name: Primary Supervisor
Description: Specify Y if this is the primary supervisor for the assignment.

Name: Reason Code
Description: The reason for the change.

Name: Supervisor Assignment ID
Description: A unique reference to the assignment of the supervisor.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Name: Reference 1
Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application. You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
